meta.name: orca-cli
meta.description: Operate Orca-managed worktrees, folder contexts, terminals, repos, automations, artifacts, skill sharing, worktree comments, and Orca's embedded browser through the `orca` CLI. Use when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "child worktree", "spawn codex/claude in a worktree", "read/wait/send Orca terminal", "handoff" / "handover" / "give this to another agent", "Orca browser", "orca artifacts", or "share skills". Prefer it over raw git worktree, ad hoc PTYs, or Computer Use when Orca state is involved. Use Computer Use only when a visible window needs GUI control that a CLI, filesystem, or API cannot do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把编码任务放进独立工作区,让多个助手并行推进并互相交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时用多个编码助手,想让他们分工又方便交接
copy.tagline_en: Run coding tasks in isolated workspaces and hand them off between assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle several coding assistants and want them to split work and hand off

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 `orca` CLI 操作 Orca 的工作树、终端、仓库、自动化、工件、技能共享、工作树评论和内嵌浏览器。它会先为本次会话选定可执行文件，再加载版本匹配的指南。
howto.when: 当你说出 “$orca-cli”、“Orca worktree”、“handoff” 等关键词，或任务涉及 Orca 状态时触发；此时优先用它，而非原生 git worktree 等替代方案。

say.text: 用 $orca-cli 加载本次会话的版本匹配指南
say.note: 执行 ORCA skills get orca-cli

say.text: 在 Orca 子工作树里启动一个 claude 会话
say.note: 通过 orca CLI 创建子工作树并运行

say.text: 把这个任务 handoff 给另一个 agent
say.note: 借助 Orca 终端转交任务

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the `orca` CLI to operate Orca worktrees, terminals, repos, artifacts, skill sharing, comments, and its embedded browser. It first resolves the session's executable, then loads the version-matched guide.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "$orca-cli", "Orca worktree", "handoff", etc., or when the task involves Orca state; prefer it over raw git worktree and similar alternatives.

say_en.text: Spawn a claude session in an Orca child worktree
Hand this task off to another agent
